items: 【L-SHAPED DESIGN FITS AROUND PIPES AND GARBAGE DISPOSALS】 The narrow top basket mounts left or right to clear your plumbing. The wide lower tier reclaims full vertical space under the sink, turning a blocked corner into organized, easy-to-use cabinet storage.

【SMOOTH PULL-OUT DRAWER FOR INSTANT ACCESS】 The bottom basket rides on smooth glides. One pull brings every bottle, sponge, or bag within reach — no kneeling, no reaching blindly into the back of the cabinet. Slide it closed with a gentle push.

【HOLDS UP TO 50 LBS — METAL FRAME BUILT TO LAST】 The all-metal frame supports up to 50 lbs total. Baked-on coating resists moisture and cleaning spray. This under-sink organizer holds its shape year after year, unlike plastic shelves that sag over time.

【GRID BASKETS STAY CLEAN WITH MINIMAL EFFORT】 Open wire mesh lets water and debris fall through instead of pooling on a solid tray. Raised-edge guards keep bottles from tipping. Wipe it down in seconds — no scrubbing, no disassembly, no hidden grime.

items.label: 【FITS MOST STANDARD CABINETS WITHOUT TOOLS】 Assembled dimensions
items.value: 14.2 in W x 10.6 in D x 11 in H. Requires cabinet interior of at least 11 in W x 15 in D x 16 in H. Non-slip silicone pads grip the cabinet floor, keeping the unit steady with every pull.

items: 【KITCHEN, BATHROOM, AND LAUNDRY ROOM READY】 Use it as a kitchen cabinet organizer under the sink, a bathroom cabinet organizer under the vanity, or a laundry room storage shelf beside the washer: 1 organizer, 3 spaces, zero wasted potential.

【ARRIVES MOSTLY ASSEMBLED AND EASY TO SET UP】 The main frame comes pre-assembled. Connect the uprights, position the baskets, and your under-cabinet storage is ready—no drill, no complicated steps — just a cleaner, calmer cabinet in minutes.
